answer: Here is one mechanism that works: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because saffron only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, tundra is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any reef approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
